{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: price-generator

on:
  push:
    branches: 
    - master
    paths:
    - '.github/workflows/price-generator.yml'
    - 'apps/price-generator/**'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-18.04
    steps:
    - name: Checkout project
      uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - name: Setup Java JDK
      uses: actions/setup-java@v1.4.3
      with:
        java-version: 11
    - name: Cache Maven dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.m2/repository
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-m2-${{ hashFiles('apps/price-generator/pom.xml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-m2-
    - name: Maven build
      working-directory: apps/price-generator
      run: ./mvnw package -Pnative -Dquarkus.native.container-build=true",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a Maven/Java build that re-fetches dependencies on every run. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (Cache dependency downloads) applies: cache the dependency download state (~/.m2/repository) keyed on the pom.xml manifest, while keeping the full mvnw package build and its tests intact. Preconditions hold: repeated dependency fetching is measurable and the cache input is the pinned dependency manifest. Contraindications are avoided: no equivalent cache exists, and only dependency download state is cached (not build outputs/target), so required build and test coverage is preserved. No permissions are weakened and no secrets, publishing, deployment, or new network access is added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
